content: The media-runner owns rootless processing of explicitly mounted media and its stable command/output contract. Inputs arrive through producer-provided mounts; operations are narrowly media transforms (for example image/video processing), and outputs are written to the declared output mount with deterministic paths, metadata, and exit behavior. R2 and other credentials stay at the transfer boundary and are never passed through media mounts, logged, or embedded in output artifacts. Producers prepare inputs and invoke the runner; consumers retrieve and publish verified outputs. Astro components, Tina/content ownership, layout policy, Instagram scheduling, and the canonical Senshac tracker remain outside this repository.
